title: Enterprise feature intake rapid-triage workflow and CS handoff matrix
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Create a repeatable rapid-triage workflow and a CS->PM handoff matrix for enterprise feature requests (non-bug). The goal is to reduce backlog wobble, provide consistent initial scoping, and give Sales/CS clear SLAs and outcomes so we can prioritize high-value work quickly. This ticket defines the intake form fields, numeric scoring rubric, routing rules, and a minimal set of artifacts required for a PM to take ownership (scoping brief, stakeholder list, and initial cost/opportunity estimate).
intake_form_fields: Data sensitivity / compliance notes (PII, HIPAA, SOC2, etc.)
Success criteria (how customer will measure value)
Attachments: sample prompts, logs, or reproducible steps
triage_rubric: Revenue signal (1-5): committed ARR or near-term expansion likelihood
Strategic alignment (1-5): matches roadmap themes (privacy, performance, routing)
Implementation risk (1-5): infra changes, new infra dependencies, or major runtime work
Security/compliance sensitivity (1-5): requires KMS/HSM, audit/pen tests, or legal review
Customer urgency (1-5): launch date vs. effort
routing_rules: Score >= 18: Fast-track -> PM triage meeting same-week; expected outcome: committed scoping and timeline
Score 12-17: Scoped into discovery backlog; PM to request clarifying artifacts and plan a 2-week discovery spike
Score < 12: Triage to backlog with rebuttal template to AE/CS explaining gating factors
Any request with security_score >=4 must open a security intake ticket before PM ownership
hand_off_matrix: AE/CS provides intake form + attachments -> PM confirms receipt within 24h
PM does initial scoring and sets outcome in Slack channel #pm-enterprise within 48h
Engineering consult (if score >=14 or infra-impact indicated) must be scheduled within 5 business days
If discovery is approved, create GH issue under repo docs/roadmap and link Confluence scoping doc
If rejected, AE/CS receives a templated reply with list of remediable items and suggested next steps
required_artifacts_for_pm_takeover: Sample prompts and expected outputs or failure cases
Customer success criteria and target metrics
Commercial signal / ARR or contract reference
List of impacted Redwood products (API, Dedicated, Private) and known constraints
sla_and_cadence: PM->Eng consultation scheduling (when needed): within 5 business days
Bi-weekly intake review meeting: Friday 14:00 PT
Pilot/Discovery timebox suggested: 2 weeks unless blocked
pilot_notes: Piloted form and rubric with 3 AEs and 2 CS reps during Feb 2026; found missing field: 'existing workaround' - added to intake
Pilot feedback: scoring weights under-value infrastructure cost; increased implementation risk weight in rubric
Observed friction: security intake loop was manual; propose automation via ServiceNow->PM webhook
alternatives_considered: Full ticket enrichment by AE (too slow for quick wins)
Allow PMs to auto-escalate based on keywords in request (high false positives)
Centralized intake team to pre-score requests (requires headcount; deferred)
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Decision: Use lightweight numeric rubric to keep triage fast even though it sacrifices nuance
Tradeoff: Some high-touch enterprise asks will need manual overrides; PMs retain final authority to escalate
Decision: Require security intake for anything with high compliance signal to avoid late-stage surprises
